recipe.visualDefinition: A central high-contrast black and white profile portrait of a man, flanked by two semi-transparent 'echo' silhouettes in deep blue and vibrant red, set against a dark, textured navy background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central high-contrast B&W subject as the primary focal point
Symmetrical color echoes (blue on left, red on right) creating a sense of motion
Dark, moody background providing depth for the bright facial highlights
Minimalist sans-serif typography balancing the complex visual layering
coreInvariants: Leather jacket texture in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, high-contrast bridge of the nose and eye area of the central B&W figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Horizontal scan from the blue shadow on the left, through the sharp central face, to the red shadow on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep navy textured space in the top corners and bottom edges.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cobalt Blue and Crimson Red (Echo silhouettes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the center; low saturation in the background; high saturation in the color overlays.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or overlapping characters in the primary logo area
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, tight display type paired with light, airy, wide-tracked subtitle type.
graphicDevices: Triangular monogram logo in bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight for the display role.
Ideal for the wide-tracked, clean subtitle role.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast B&W profile portrait of a man in a leather jacket. Layer a semi-transparent blue version of the profile shifted to the left and a semi-transparent red version shifted to the right. Set against a dark navy background with subtle grunge texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, geometric sans-serif logo in the top left with tight spacing. Apply a light, wide-tracked sans-serif title in the top right. Add a small triangular monogram in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the central face sharp and B&W?
Are the color echoes transparent enough to see the background through them?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the display tracking?
Is the background a dark navy rather than pure black?

adjustableVariables: Horizontal offset distance of the echoes
Saturation of the red and blue hues
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
Specific facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between the red and blue layers
Ensure the leather jacket texture is visible in the shadows
Verify typography is legible against the dark background
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W subject with offset RGB color channels (specifically Red and Blue) against a textured dark field, topped with high-contrast geometric typography.
